messages:
alex: quick planning thread — need to align on Q3 region onboarding priorities and GPU SKU tradeoffs. main ask: decide phasing strategy for eu-central and ap-northeast + H100 vs A100 mix.

mia: adding context — two enterprise pilots want eu by Aug, one requires <70ms p95 for short-chat flows. they can pay for reserved capacity if needed.

jon: current procurement lead times: H100 12-16 weeks, A100 6-10. pricing delta ~25%.

rachel: we also have spot/backfill options but not for enterprise SLAs. For Dedicated customers we need reserve or committed pool.

diego: utilization target reminder: 70% steady-state, allow 2x burst headroom. if we overcommit H100 we'd blow CAPEX.

alex: proposal A: prioritize eu-central with mixed pool (40% H100, 60% A100), reserve enough for pilot SLAs, rely on spot for non-critical tasks.

mia: proposal B: prioritize ap-northeast first (larger pilot customer), go heavier on A100 there, shift H100 to NA and EU later.

jon: feasibility note: vendor channel has a 4-week allocation window for A100 in ap-northeast but H100 is scarce.

rachel: thought — can we short-circuit by offering customers a regional latency SLA with regional fallback? e.g., eu customers route to NA with cached KV for 50% of requests. reduces immediate footprint.

alex: good idea. fallback policy would be product change + consent. Is that acceptable to pilot customers? @mia

mia: one pilot is ok with fallback as long as we mark degraded latency and no data residency loss. the other insists on EU-only for compliance.

diego: budget constraints: finance capped incremental capex at $3.2M this quarter for procurement. that buys ~40 H100-equivalent or ~55 A100-equivalent.

jon: math check: if we target eu with 20 H100 and ap-northeast with 30 A100, leaves ~5 H100 buffer. That fits budget-ish. but lead times risk.

rachel: launch criteria checklist suggestion: 1) pilot SLA validated on perf harness; 2) reserve pool provisioned; 3) routing + fallback policy wired; 4) cost burn estimate under alerting thresholds.

alex: agree. also add: success metric = <70ms p95 for 90% of pilot traffic without falling back more than 10% of requests.

mia: action items: @jon confirm lead-time guarantees with vendor by EOD Tue. @diego produce capex allocation vs SKU mix spreadsheet. @rachel draft fallback messaging and routing config. I'll sync with pilots about EU-only requirement.

jon: I'll ping vendor and post the PO timeline.

diego: starting spreadsheet now, will share link.

rachel: drafting routing config. sample policy snippet:```json
{
  "route": "eu-central",
  "fallback": ["na-west-2"],
  "max_fallback_pct": 10
}
```

alex: minor ops ask — please add autoscaling headroom rules per SKU. A100 scales differently than H100.

diego: noted. will include burst sizing and cooldown windows.

orchard-bot: Reminder: capacity planning doc due in 5 days. Attachments: /docs/capacity/q3-onboarding-draft.md

alex: thanks all. next sync Thu 11am. if vendor says H100 delayed, we'll fallback to plan B and accelerate A100 buys in APAC. :+1:

mia: ack.

jon: ack.
